---
title: "Publications"
---

<p class="section-kicker">

Full list on [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=KpsXogEAAAAJ&hl=en).

</p>

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(RefManageR)

bib <- ReadBib("publications.bib", check = FALSE)

# Small helper: always returns a length-1 value, never NULL / character(0) / numeric(0)
safe_field <- function(x, default = "") {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(default)
  x[[1]]
}

# Build one record per entry
recs <- lapply(seq_along(bib), function(i) {
  entry <- bib[[i]]

  year_raw <- safe_field(entry$year, safe_field(entry$date, NA_character_))
  year_num <- if (is.na(year_raw)) {
    NA_real_
  } else {
    yn <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("\\D.*", "", as.character(year_raw))))
    if (length(yn) == 0 || is.na(yn)) NA_real_ else yn
  }

  authors <- entry$author
  author_str <- ""
  if (!is.null(authors) && length(authors) > 0) {
    names_fmt <- format(authors, include = c("given", "family"))
    n <- length(names_fmt)
    author_str <- if (n > 1) {
      paste0(paste(names_fmt[1:(n - 1)], collapse = ", "), ", and ", names_fmt[n])
    } else {
      names_fmt
    }
  }

  title <- safe_field(entry$title, "")
  journal <- safe_field(entry$journal, safe_field(entry$journaltitle, ""))
  vol <- safe_field(entry$volume, "")
  pages <- safe_field(entry$pages, "")
  extra_parts <- c(vol, pages)
  extra_parts <- extra_parts[nchar(extra_parts) > 0]
  extra <- paste(extra_parts, collapse = ": ")

  url <- safe_field(entry$url, "")
  if (nchar(url) == 0) {
    doi <- safe_field(entry$doi, "")
    if (nchar(doi) > 0) url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
  }

  meta <- paste0(author_str, ". <em>", journal, "</em>",
                 if (nchar(extra) > 0) paste0(" ", extra) else "", ".")

  list(year = year_num, title = title, meta = meta, url = if (nchar(url) > 0) url else NULL)
})

# Split into dated vs undated, so undated always lands at the bottom
has_year <- vapply(recs, function(r) !is.na(r$year), logical(1))
dated <- recs[has_year]
undated <- recs[!has_year]

# Dated: newest year first, then alphabetical by title within a year
if (length(dated) > 0) {
  ord <- order(-vapply(dated, function(r) r$year, numeric(1)),
               vapply(dated, function(r) r$title, character(1)))
  dated <- dated[ord]
}
# Undated: alphabetical by title, always after all dated entries
if (length(undated) > 0) {
  ord2 <- order(vapply(undated, function(r) r$title, character(1)))
  undated <- undated[ord2]
}

all_recs <- c(dated, undated)
year_labels <- vapply(all_recs, function(r) if (is.na(r$year)) "" else as.character(r$year), character(1))

# Render one .pub-item per year GROUP, listing every paper from that year together
n <- length(all_recs)
i <- 1
while (i <= n) {
  current_year <- year_labels[i]
  j <- i
  while (j < n && year_labels[j + 1] == current_year) j <- j + 1

  cat('<div class="pub-item">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<span class="pub-year">%s</span>\n', current_year))
  cat('<div>\n')
  for (k in i:j) {
    r <- all_recs[[k]]
    if (!is.null(r$url)) {
      cat(sprintf('<p class="pub-title"><a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a></p>\n', r$url, r$title))
    } else {
      cat(sprintf('<p class="pub-title">%s</p>\n', r$title))
    }
    cat(sprintf('<p class="pub-meta" style="margin-bottom:16px;">%s</p>\n', r$meta))
  }
  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n\n')

  i <- j + 1
}
```
